name: LEGO Bluey Shorts
overview: Bluey’s fans worldwide can enjoy their favorite blue canine in a new way today as BBC Studios and LEGO Entertainment introduce a short-form series online. LEGO Bluey Shorts, a 10 x 2-minute series is now available to view on the official Bluey channel, the LEGO channel and the LEGO Little One Channel on Youtube as well as Bluey.TV. New episodes, which are available in 12 languages.
